LESSON: PUNCTUATIONS AND INDICATORS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: French Braille
Topic 8.3: Punctuations and Indicators
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Punctuations and Indicators, part of French Braille in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we use punctuation marks when writing braille work? 2. How do you differentiate punctuation marks from letters of the alphabet?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify punctuation signs in French braille by naming the dots.
